subject: Showcase films: Swedish place-name pronunciation in scene 1 (sv + en)
description: Tobias read the 22 place names of the 16 showcase films in Swedish (2026-11-03) and chose, from auditions, to use them for both languages: scene 1 of 15 films per language is re-narrated with his place-name readings as continuation prompts (sv-B: place-name prompt + Swedish narrator reference; en-B: George sentence + place-name prompt + British reference). This replaces the 30 affected MP4s, captions and posters under docs/showcase/films and updates MANIFEST.json to the new media commit. No player or page code changes. Review: Codex.
